INDIGOTAILOR-UNDERDOCKS_LOOM_HOUSE.title: The Underdocks Loom-House
INDIGOTAILOR-UNDERDOCKS_LOOM_HOUSE.pages: You step into a half-submerged loom-house in the Underdocks. Glowing cyan warp threads still hum across a rusted iron loom beside a bubbling stone vat of fermented indigo.
Permanently stitch 1 [gold]Crimson Needle Patch+[/gold] and 1 [gold]Indigo Lining Patch+[/gold] onto a card in your Deck.
The caustic dye stings your fingers, but you pull a pair of ancient brass buttons from the sunken silk.
Aged indigo seeps along the needle tracks, binding blade and lining permanently into the weave.
With one decisive snap of your giant shears, you harvest the brass fittings and move on.
